approval: User approved the repaired entry and requested that every future daily entry be at least this good.
use: Minimum quality reference. Match the clarity, specificity, visual finish and usability. Develop an original identity and composition for each new product; do not reuse this palette, layout, artwork, wording or jokes as a template.

criteria.comprehension: A first-time visitor understands the audience, source-product mechanic, actual action and absurd consequence from the page itself. Specialist terms are explained through concrete actions.
criteria.satire: Features develop distinct recognizable audience behaviors through actual source-product mechanics. Jokes work on first reading, testimonials recount specific consequences, and pricing perks name intelligible entitlements.
criteria.composition: The opening presents a clear proposition, primary CTA and recognizable product visual. Every image explains the audience or an action; captions are readable and aligned. Typography, spacing, image scale and section hierarchy are at least as finished as the approved reference on desktop and mobile.
criteria.continuity: Landing and demo describe the same product. Prominent controls and chapter/deep links work; plan previews are honest; counters and feedback agree with actions. Navigation, controls and text remain usable on narrow screens.
